title: Ex-Slack Founders Launch Scuba With $34M For AI Context Engine
summary:
Noah Desai Weiss and Dolapo Falola have introduced a tool to coordinate information between corporate teams and digital assistants. The New York based startup, Scuba, raised $34M in funding through pre-seed and seed rounds led by venture firms Accel and IVP. The founders, both former product leaders at Slack, are building a "context engine" to serve as a shared memory hub for employees and artificial intelligence agents, with backing from angel investors including Reid Hoffman, Patrick Collison, and Drew Houston.

The platform organizes articles, voice notes, images, and tweets into shared "Collections" and integrates with services such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor via the Model Context Protocol. Scuba operates with a team of 10 people and has released the software in limited, free access for browser extensions, Windows, Mac, and iOS.
